# Requirements Quality Checklist: Unified Printable Catalog Exporter (PDF, TXT, RTF)

**Purpose**: Validate quality, clarity, completeness, and consistency of requirements for Feature 011 before tasks creation and implementation
**Created**: 2026-11-22
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all universal field toggles explicitly enumerated with their default active/inactive states across all export formats? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Are dimension presets completely defined with their exact width and height values in both metric and imperial units? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the schema properties and default fallbacks for embedded JSON themes exhaustively specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK004 Are error handling requirements specified when an export directory lacks write permissions or disk space? [Completeness, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Are atomic file replacement requirements defined across all target formats to prevent leftover temporary files? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]

## Requirement Clarity & Precision

- [ ] CHK006 Is the mathematical conversion ratio between physical units (`cm`, `mm`, `in`) and PDF points (`pt`) explicitly quantified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the threshold for the visual readability warning quantified with an exact point size number rather than subjective phrasing? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the rules for single-line text truncation and ellipsis behavior within narrow column widths unambiguously documented? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the minimum allowed physical dimension quantified with a strict lower boundary value? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the live layout feedback format specified with exact metrics displayed to the user? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Consistency & Alignment

- [ ] CHK011 Do universal field toggles behave consistently across PDF, Plain Text, and Rich Text outputs without format-specific discrepancies? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK012 Does the superseding of planned DOCX export align across all requirements, roadmap items, and historical references? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK013 Are default dimension presets consistent between the GUI modal defaults and the CLI invocation defaults? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK014 Are margins and padding boundaries defined consistently between custom dimensions and predefined presets? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 Are requirements specified for handling an empty playlist when the user triggers the export action? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements specified for single-track playlists to prevent division-by-zero or empty-column rendering glitches? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 Are requirements defined for extreme track title lengths (e.g. 200+ characters) to guarantee columns never collide? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements defined for international characters and Unicode track metadata when using embedded fonts? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK019 Are dialog layout requirements specified for narrow viewport resolutions down to 300 × 400 px? [Coverage, Edge Cases, Spec §SC-007]

## Measurability & Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK020 Can physical print scale accuracy be verified objectively against a measurable tolerance threshold? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK021 Can the execution time target for document generation be verified objectively without implementation bias? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK022 Can the real-time UI calculation latency target be objectively benchmarked during user interaction? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK023 Can the zero-byte temporary file leftover guarantee be verified deterministically upon operation cancellation or error? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Non-Functional & Governance Constraints

- [ ] CHK024 Are standalone release binary footprint constraints (< 20 MB ceiling) explicitly reflected in technical boundaries? [Constraint, Constitution Principle I]
- [ ] CHK025 Are cross-platform headless testing requirements via `egui_kittest` under `cargo test` explicitly stipulated for the export dialog? [Constraint, Constitution Principle V]
- [ ] CHK026 Are offline-first requirements preserved with zero runtime network or external process dependencies? [Constraint, Constitution Principle IV]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- Items are numbered sequentially (CHK001–CHK026) for traceability
